title: Amazon's 767 Crash Gets Grimmer, London Grinds to a Halt, and Delta Quietly Shrinks Vegas
summary: The NTSB drops new flight data from Sunday's fatal Amazon cargo crash in Miami, and it raises more questions than it answers. Heathrow and the rest of London's airports basically shut down after an air traffic control glitch, Delta trims five routes heading into winter, and American and Hyatt are calling it quits. Plus, GE just wrote an $11.75 billion check to fix a problem that's been grounding planes.
